Best-Fit Breakdown
Option 1:   Mount Eden (Listing 1)     Best overall match for your criteria     Best value among qualifying options
- Meets every requirement: 2 bed,   720 NZD/week  , in-unit laundry,   28-minute   transit commute.
- Strong balance of cost and commute time.
- No parking is the only notable downside, but that was not one of your required criteria.
Option 2:   Ellerslie (Listing 4)     Second-best qualifying option     Most feature-rich qualifying option
- Also meets every requirement: 2 bed,   745 NZD/week  , in-unit laundry,   34-minute   train commute.
- Small balcony is a nice extra.
- Weaker than Mount Eden only because it is closer to both your max budget and max commute threshold.
Option 3:   Onehunga (Listing 3)     Budget-friendly but misses a core requirement     Laundry deal-breaker
- Price and commute are both good:   690 NZD/week  ,   31-minute   train.
-   Shared laundry   conflicts directly with your in-unit laundry requirement.
- Worth considering only if you decide laundry is flexible.
Option 4:   Newmarket (Listing 2)     Fastest commute but over budget     Price deal-breaker
- Excellent   18-minute   train commute and includes in-unit laundry plus   1 parking spot  .
-   780 NZD/week   exceeds your   760 NZD/week   maximum.
- Only makes sense if you can stretch your budget.
